content:
For the patch notes, see Fallout 76 patch 1.7.25.13.

***Infestations*** is the twenty-seventh major update for *Fallout 76*. It was released on June 2, 2026. [1] It was preceded by *The Backwoods*.

The update includes the Infestation gameplay mechanic, providing a new type of hostile encounter in the game world, as well as the twenty-fifth season: *Appalachia Under Siege*.

## Features[]

- Season 25: *Appalachia Under Siege*
- Infestation - This repeatable endgame quest content can appear randomly at a slate of pre-existing locations, where hostile enemies have taken over the area.
 - The Exploration public team type has been revamped for Infestations.
- New four-star legendary mods, including Hauler's, Raging, Satiated, Tarnished, and Vector.
- Fishing expansion - New, seasonal fish have been added that can only be fished during spring, summer, fall, and winter. These fish are not turned into fish bits and are instead used to craft new seasonal food recipes.
- Additional balancing changes to armor, aimed at improving the user experience with armor condition.
- Buffs to Radiation Resistance and relevant items, as well as several related changes to the playable ghoul race and environmental radiation in various locations and as dealt by enemies.
- New rewards for Grahm's Meat-Cook.

## Behind the scenes[]

- The Public Test Server patch notes for this update initially used the title *Protecting Appalachia* . The final title of the update,*Infestations* , was not revealed until its formal announcement on May 20, two weeks prior to release. [1] 
- Relevant editor IDs indicate that Infestations were originally referred to as "hostile takeovers," also abbreviated as HTO.
- Following the live release of this update, Bethesda Game Studios released a statement acknowledging player disappointment with the rewards in season 25 and other recent seasons. The team stated they would be bringing "more, higher value rewards that are themed to be in line with the content for the update accompanying it" starting with the next update, while also providing "fewer rewards that are alternative colors of already existing items" and pledging they would "lean into providing rewards that are unique and new." This statement was published to the Bethesda Game Studios official Discord and the *Infestations* patch notes were amended to include this statement. [2]
